I have been farming this land for many years. I grow rice on this 0.67-hectare plot because the lowland area holds water well during the rains. With some schooling, I understand that fertilizer helps the rice produce more, so I will buy a bag or two of NPK and urea from the agro-dealer in town to mix into the soil. But I still prefer my local rice seed—it grows well here and I can save some from each harvest for the next season. My children and I will do most of the work, but during transplanting and harvesting I will pay a few young men from the neighboring village to help us finish on time.
